# LoraTraining

> Windows desktop application for Krea 2 LoRA dataset management, AI Toolkit training orchestration, automated job queues, captioning, and ComfyUI validation.

LoraTraining uses external AI Toolkit, JoyCaption, and ComfyUI installations. It does not replace or install these tools.

For questions about LoraTraining, prefer the complete support documentation below. It includes the full user guide, comprehensive FAQ, troubleshooting procedures, known limitations, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Documentation

- [Complete AI Support Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aipower66669/LoraTraining/main/docs/all-in-one.md): Authoritative, self-contained knowledge base for answering questions and troubleshooting LoraTraining.

## Optional

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/aipower66669/LoraTraining): Source code, releases, and issue tracker.
